LanguageData.Battery_Advanced.label: advanced battery
LanguageData.Battery_Advanced.description:
A battery enhanced with advanced components and uranium for optimal capacity efficiency and weight. Advanced batteries will not short-circuit in rain, not break down, and generate no heat.
Capacity: 1250 Wd Efficiency: 90%
LanguageData.Battery_Gold.label: golden battery
LanguageData.Battery_Gold.description:
A battery enhanced with gold for optimal efficiency. Gold batteries will short-circuit in rain and can break down, but generate no heat.
Capacity: 750 Wd Efficiency: 90%
LanguageData.Battery_Plasteel.label: plasteel battery
LanguageData.Battery_Plasteel.description:
A battery enhanced with plasteel for enhanced capacity, durability and weight. Plasteel batteries will not short-circuit in rain, not break down, and generate no heat.
Capacity: 1250 Wd Efficiency: 50%
LanguageData.Battery_Silver.label: silver battery
LanguageData.Battery_Silver.description:
A battery enhanced with silver for improved capacity and efficiency. Silver batteries will short-circuit in rain, can break down, but generate no heat.
Capacity: 1000 Wd Efficiency: 70%
LanguageData.Battery_Uranium.label: uranium battery
LanguageData.Battery_Uranium.description:
A battery enhanced with uranium. It has exceptional capacity and efficiency, but loses 1% efficiency for every 1°C it is above 20°C (or every 1.8°F above 68°F). Uranium batteries will not break down, but can short-circuit in rain and generate heat. They will also violently explode if destroyed.
Capacity: 1500 Wd Efficiency: 90%
LanguageData.Battery_Vanometric.label: vanometric battery
LanguageData.Battery_Vanometric.description:
A battery developed by archotechs. It is believed it stores energy in the quantum foam and can extract it from there without any loss. Vanometric batteries will not short-circuit in rain, not break down, and generate no heat.
Capacity: 2500 Wd Efficiency: 100%
